_note: How box and dropbox answer a write sent with their own version, for both hosts' refusal mapping. lost = the file changed since the version sent (the refused write keeps that version); gone = the file is no longer there (keeps none); other = keeps its own meaning. Box carries the HTTP status; dropbox carries the error_summary of a 409.
_evidence: box: 412 precondition_failed on a stale If-Match (upload 2026-10-05, delete 2026-10-08), 404 not_found once gone (2026-10-08). dropbox: upload update mode 409 path/conflict (2026-10-04/05), delete_v2 parent_rev 409 path_write/conflict/file/ and path_lookup/not_found/ (2026-10-08).
